snippet.title: THE CANON OF BALLS --- Official Trailer
snippet.description:
ARE YOU READY TO ROLL AND LICK?! TOGETHER WITH FRIENDS OR SOLO!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3962460/THE_CANON_OF_BALLS/

THE CANON OF BALLS is the hardcore, first-person platforming experience you and your friends have been waiting for. Imagine putting Shadow of the Colossus' PSX aesthetics and Monkey Ball's gameplay into a blender and mixing them thoroughly. What comes out is an easy-to-learn, hard-to-master open-world multiplayer experience to explore and master together with your friends. A vast open world, with each platforming track bringing its own interesting twist, is waiting for you — all of this with no hand-holding. There are no minimaps, quest markers, or tutorials that treat you like you're dumb.
